subject: What kind of kurtosis calculates Deducer?

messages.author: 3871a2787d9649e8
messages.subject: What kind of kurtosis calculates Deducer?
parts: Kurtosis characterizes peakedness, where the normal distribution has a value of 3 and smaller values correspond to thinner tails (less peakedness). Some packages substract three (3) from the kurtosis, so that the normal distribution has a kurtosis of 0 (this is sometimes called "excess kurtosis". What kind of kurtosis calculates Deducer (menu Analysis>Descriptives)?

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: What kind of kurtosis calculates Deducer?
parts:
Deducer uses type two, the same as SAS/SPSS

G_2 = ((n+1) g_2 + 6) * (n-1) / ((n-2)(n-3))

ian
